description: Recent token transfers for one Base wallet, incoming and outgoing, newest first: token, symbol, amount, sender, recipient, transaction hash, block and time, with likely spam airdrops flagged. Filter by one token or by direction, up to 50 per call. Reports the block window searched. Useful for checking a counterparty's activity, confirming deposits, reconciling payments, or watching an agent's wallet. Read-only. Not charged for invalid input or when Base can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
